facts.value: In analog computers data is stored using continuous physical quantities. A mechanical integrator is an example of an analogue computer.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Science in Computer Systems

facts.value: These are the most common types of computers found in the market today. Data is processed in digital computers using discrete values. Smartphone is a common example of digital computers.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Science in Computer Systems

facts.value: These are a combination of both analogue and digital computers. Examples include complex medical equipment.
